steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope.
Just south of the Plains of Havoc temple, dig the hole open with your shovel and go down.
steps.source: Go into the hole just south of the Plains of Havoc Temple (Mapper Coords 128.47, 126.24, 7).
Kill the Giant Spider and look around.

steps.text: The northern body: a bag with 5 power bolts and 12 burst arrows.
steps.source: The northern body contains a Brown Bag with in it 5 Power Bolts and 12 Burst Arrows.

steps.text: The pile of bones: a two handed sword.
steps.source: The pile of bones contains the Two Handed Sword.

steps.text: The body below the teleporter: The Dreammaster book.
steps.source: The body directly below the teleporter contains the The Dreammaster Book.
